verdict.rationale: Graphite documents a codebase-aware AI review agent that automatically reviews every PR, identifies potential issues, and catches bugs before they ship (graphite-docs-4, graphite-docs-16, graphite-docs-18, graphite-docs-27). Custom rules and comment exclusions can steer it away from noise (graphite-docs-5, graphite-docs-20), and it tracks issues found and acceptance rates (graphite-docs-49). However, nothing shows it finds substantive defects rather than nits. Missing for 10: documentation of what bug classes it detects (logic errors, race conditions, edge cases), published accuracy or false-positive data, and independent or hands-on corroboration of real bug-catching.
